descriptor.retrieval_description: Flexible foil drink pouch with a smooth, dry metallic exterior and printed plastic film coating. The intended contact region is clean and pliable, featuring broad flat surfaces with sealed edge ridges.
descriptor.contact_region: The lateral front and back faces of the flexible pouch within the centered grasp band.
descriptor.contact_material: Printed plastic film laminated over aluminum foil substrate.
descriptor.visible_surface_material: Printed plastic film and metallic foil.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Clean, dry, and reflective with minor wrinkles.
descriptor.local_geometry: Broad, pliable, slightly bulging flat surfaces transitioning into sealed vertical side fins and horizontal top/bottom seams.
descriptor.uncertainty: The internal fluid shifting may alter the exact local contour and pliability under actual clamping forces.
